item.title: Trump administration expected to slash Iran war funding request
item.summary: The eventual ask of Congress is likely to fall to between $80 billion and $100 billion, officials said, less than half the amount of an earlier proposal to offset costs of the conflict.

item.title: JD Vance campaigns for far-right nationalist Viktor Orban in Hungary
item.summary: The vice president traveled to Budapest as Trump’s deadline for an Iran deal loomed Tuesday, backing the administration’s closest ideological ally in Europe.

item.title: Hegseth’s boastful claims about Iran war contradict reality, officials say
item.summary: The defense secretary’s rosy portrayal of U.S. success in the conflict risks misinforming the public and the president, observers worry.

item.title: Vance says he prays U.S. is ‘on God’s side’ in Iran war
item.summary: When asked whether he shared Trump’s view that the U.S.-Israeli war on Iran carried divine backing, the vice president declined to go as far.

item.title: Trump says God supports U.S. cause in Iran war as he threatens wider bombing
item.summary: The president offered a new rationale for the costly, unpopular conflict: “God wants to see people taken care of,” he said.

item.title: Trump’s Iran brinkmanship reaches truce, escalates backlash at home
item.summary: The president’s ultimatum drew condemnation across the political spectrum and intensified open debate about his credibility, morality and sanity.

item.title: Democrats are turning Republicans’ arguments against them in midterm races
item.summary: Republicans won in 2024 by promising to cut the cost of living, but high gas prices are frustrating voters and providing a potent line of attack ahead of this year’s elections.

item.title: Republican wins Marjorie Taylor Greene seat but by tighter margin
item.summary: Clay Fuller, backed by President Donald Trump, defeated Democrat Shawn Harris by a much smaller margin than what Republicans enjoyed in previous years in the deep-red district vacated by Marjorie Taylor Greene.

item.title: Acting AG says Trump has ‘duty’ to identify people who should be investigated
item.summary: Todd Blanche, who is leading the Justice Department after Pam Bondi’s ouster, defended investigations of the president’s political foes.

item.title: This GOP candidate seized a half-million ballots and says he may do it again
item.summary: Riverside County Sheriff Chad Bianco, who is running for California governor as a Republican, tried to review ballots despite election officials reaffirming the results.
